title.narrative: Educando para a Cidadania in Mozambique

description.narrative: The project was designed starting from the findings and lessons learnt during the observation of the 2023 local elections and taking into account the phenomena associated with this process, characterized by the high turnout and dissatisfaction with the results; there is a risk that in future electoral processes there will be a lot of abstention. The Project is designed to mitigate the impact of abstention and the potential spread of violence in Mozambique. It's important that young people and women don't give up on participating in Mozambique's political decisions and that this is important for their lives. they can engage in the peaceful choice of their rulers, and democratic institutions must serve these interests. With the implementation of the actions related to this project, it is hoped that the level of abstentions will be reduced and that young people and women will feel encouraged to participate actively in the construction of Mozambique's democratic society.
